description: This Java class 'JmsTopicListener' implements a message listener for JMS topics (publish/subscribe pattern). It manages the lifecycle of a JMS topic connection, session, and subscriber, and listens for messages on a specified topic, handling setup and cleanup operations.

classes.name: JmsTopicListener
classes.description: A JMS message listener class for subscribing to a JMS topic/publish-subscribe messaging pattern. Extends AbstractJmsListener, manages connection lifecycle, and handles message reception.

methods.name: JmsTopicListener
methods.description: Constructor initializing the listener with JNDI parameters and credentials.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the JMS session and connection, releasing resources.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Establishes connection to the JMS provider, sets up topic subscription, and registers the message listener.
